seasonLook.note: How the seasons look on the farm map (feature season-look). Only looks: nothing here changes a game rule, the golden runs do not see it. Season names: spring, summer, autumn, winter.

critters.note: Every creature that shows on the map, with the seasons it can be seen in (season-look/03). Animals and pets are named by their node id; 'pest_…' are the pests that come to eat on the fields (emoji in the order the fields pick them: the chapter's own kind first); butterflies and fireflies are perks. A creature that is out of season is simply not drawn; its rules (pests eating, animals giving) go on. tools/check_data.py warns about an animal, pet or pest without a seasons list.

animal_bees.why: In winter the bees stay in the hive, huddled together to keep warm.

pet_tortoise.why: A real tortoise sleeps through the winter, but Helpers never leave: see the question in season-look/03.

pest_slug.why: Slugs hide deep in the soil when it is cold.

pest_caterpillar.why: Caterpillars are only out in the warm months.

butterflies.why: Butterflies sleep through the winter or are not born yet.

fireflies.why: Agent's choice: real fireflies glow in early summer only; kept for three seasons so the perk does not seem lost.

flowers.note: Flowers in the grass (season-look/02): spring is full of them, summer has a few, autumn and winter none. Over the first 'changeQuestions' Time Quiz questions of a season their number moves from the last season's to this season's, one flower at a time, so they come and go. Each flower stays in its own place on the farm. Pictures: assets/deco/<name>.png (the ones in the grass pictures that have flowers); more spring flowers are listed in pictures/12.

leaves.note: Autumn leaves drifting down over the farm (season-look/01), each flipping from side to side as it falls. Only in autumn: they start falling when autumn begins and stop when it ends (the last ones fall to the ground). 'count' leaves are in the air at a time (each one is a small picture drawn every frame: keep it modest for the iPad). Pictures: assets/deco/leaf_1 … leaf_4 when they exist (pictures/12); until then a drawn leaf stands in.
